headline: Cloudflare recognized as a Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SASE Platforms
description: Gartner has recognized Cloudflare as a Visionary in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SASE Platforms report. We view this evaluation as a significant recognition of our strategy to help connect and secure workspace security and coffee shop networking, through our unique connectivity cloud approach.
